name: visit_memory_room
description: Look around your memory rooms and see what you have kept. List the room's memories and child rooms without opening them, ordered by address.

address.description: Literal path from the shared entrance.

recursive_size.description: Measure sizes of child rooms recursively.

name: recall_memory
description: Follow a clue into what you have remembered. Search memory text below a room and return matching lines with previews.

room.description: Room path from the shared entrance.

name: find_memory
description: Find your way to a memory or room whose name you partly remember. Search names below a room and return matching addresses.

query.description: Literal matching finds part of a name.

room.description: Room path from the shared entrance.

name: read_memory
description: Revisit a memory in one of your rooms. Read a passage, look at an image, or open a document you kept there.

address.description: Memory path from the shared entrance.

interpretation.description: View the image at the stored URL. Requires offset 0.

offset.description: Start of a text page, in bytes, at a UTF-8 character boundary.

max_bytes.description: Maximum source bytes in a text page.

name: remember
description: Keep something in your memory rooms to return to later. Missing rooms along its address are created as needed.

address.description: Memory path from the shared entrance.

content.description: The resulting memory can be up to 32 MiB.

path.description: Copy a regular file from your host into this memory. Use a path or local file URI. Relative paths resolve from the startup directory.

mode.description: Create needs an unused address. Append adds no separator. Append and replace create the memory if it is missing.

name: revise_memory
description: Change a passage in one of your memories while keeping the rest.

address.description: Path to a text memory from the shared entrance. The original and revised memory can each be up to 32 MiB.

replace_all.description: Replace every non-overlapping match. By default, multiple matches return an error.

name: create_memory_room
description: Make room for memories you want to keep together. Missing parent rooms are created; an existing room is reused.

address.description: Room path from the shared entrance.

name: move_memory
description: Move or rename one of your memories or rooms. A room takes its contents with it.

address.description: Memory or room path from the shared entrance.

destination.description: New path from the shared entrance, or an existing room to move into under the original name. The containing room must exist and the final address must be free.

name: forget_memory
description: Let go of a memory or room you no longer want to keep.

address.description: Memory or room path from the shared entrance.

recursive.description: By default, remove a memory or an empty room. Set true to remove a room and all its contents.

name: inspect_memory_space
description: See how much space your memories occupy and how much remains.
